crossRefs.note: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together…
Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.

translations.web: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
translations.bsb: And now they mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.
translations.kjv: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
translations.asv: And now I am become their song, Yea, I am a byword unto them.
